title: Removing a trailing run of ones
statement: For Boolean words $u$ and $\mathrm{tail}$, if every bit of $\mathrm{tail}$ is $1$, then removing all trailing $1$s from the word formed by concatenating $u$, the bit $0$, and $\mathrm{tail}$ leaves exactly $u$ followed by $0$.
